details: At a8bbdf7a list_chats executes ZAI_CHAT_LIST_EXPRESSION and validates origin/status/IDs only. It never reads self.account_scope, unlike read_chat which hashes returned user_id and compares expected scope. If login in same browser context changes after attach, list_chats returns new account IDs as previous bound reader. Source-confirmed, no live account switching done. Browser owner; require per-read evidence and mismatch/unverifiable rejection; do not invent account identity for empty list.
